notes.title: New Level Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44430273/d0d98540c64e63613e51e5c611cb192c2821a277.png

SWORDCAR STAGE 1

NEW LEVEL - FACTORY, find out how the sausage is made in a sprawling facility.

NEW CAR - LAZLO, An italian inspired supercar with a poleaxe, high damage requiring great skill.

NEW CAR - F-666, All American pickup truck with a switchblade that only extends during BLADE RUSH, requiring mastery of the mechanic with high damage reward

NEW SPELL - TRENCH GUN, satisfying to use pump action shotgun doing high damage at close range

NEW SPELL - COMPOUND BOW, charge to increase damage and radius with a high damaging piercing spell

NEW FEATURE - Choose a color scheme for your selected car

NEW FEATURE - Level select, play a selected level to try to set your best time and score or unlock cars and spells

NEW FEATURE - High score and time are now tracked and can be viewed in the level select screen

OTHER STUFF
Persistent check points, you can quit and pick up where you left off
Reworked lighting model, face lift for the whole game!
Reworked first level, including, but especially the tutorial and The Manager fight
Reworked jump mechanic
Rebalanced many enemies
Level reset, if you are dead, hit start and you can decide to reset the whole level
Many, Many, Many, bug fixes
Many Balance Changes

notes.title: Hotfix 0.0.3
notes.content:
Just did a few quick things that I could get done before leaving for vacation.  Cheers, and thanks to the players in the discord for bringing up bugs and suggestions!!

[Add] In-game Timer
[Add] Timer settings: on, off, always (ignores UI switch offs on cinematics)
[Fix] Deway front brass knuckle not damaging many enemy types
[Fix] Clamped knockback effect of Deway front brass knuckle to reduce chance of physics anomalies
